parts.zh: M: 你的学位论文写得怎么样了？我正在校对初稿
W: 哦，我连写都还没开始写呢
M: 你是说你连动笔都还没动？终稿还有五个月就要交了
W: 我当然已经开始了
M: 也许问题出在你做研究的方式上
M: 嗯，我建议你换个新选题
W: 回想起来，我真希望当时听了他的话
M: 如果你坚持用现在的选题
W: 是《国内南方民间传说中对女性形象的刻画》
M: 那范围确实挺窄的

items.stem: What does the woman say about her dissertation?

choices.text: She hasn't started writing it.
choices.zh: 她还没有开始写。

choices.text: She hasn't decided on a topic.
choices.zh: 她还没有确定题目。

choices.text: She is proofreading the first draft.
choices.zh: 她正在校对初稿。

choices.text: She is working on the references.
choices.zh: 她正在整理参考文献。

items.stem: What does the man say about his professor?

choices.text: He lent many books to the man for reference.
choices.zh: 他借给男士许多书供参考。

choices.text: He offered the man advice on resource hunting
choices.zh: 他就资源搜寻向男士提供了建议。

choices.text: He published a lot in a number of reputable journals.
choices.zh: 他在多个知名期刊上发表了大量文章。

choices.text: He told the man to be selective when using e-resources.
choices.zh: 他告诉男士在使用电子资源时要有选择性。

items.stem: What does the woman say about her professor?

choices.text: He didn't think her dissertation topic viable.
choices.zh: 他认为她的论文题目不可行。

choices.text: He wasn't interested in her dissertation topic.
choices.zh: 他对她的论文题目不感兴趣。

choices.text: He didn't want her to rush through her dissertation.
choices.zh: 他不希望她仓促完成论文。

choices.text: He wasn't specific about the length of her dissertation.
choices.zh: 他没有具体说明她的论文篇幅。

items.stem: What do we learn the woman will do to complete her dissertation?

choices.text: Change her research methodology.
choices.zh: 改变她的研究方法。

choices.text: Narrow down her dissertation topic.
choices.zh: 缩小她的论文题目范围。

choices.text: Consult her professor more.
choices.zh: 多咨询她的教授。

choices.text: Follow the man's advice.
choices.zh: 听从男士的建议。

items.stem: What does the woman say about the man in her introduction?

choices.text: He has translated 12 books.
choices.zh: 他已经翻译了12本书。

choices.text: He is a well-known nutritionist.
choices.zh: 他是一位知名的营养学家。

choices.text: His books sell well worldwide.
choices.zh: 他的书在全球销量很好。

choices.text: His latest book sold a million copies.
choices.zh: 他的最新著作售出了一百万册。

items.stem: What has motivated the man to write his books?

choices.text: The desire of Americans to try exotic cuisines.
choices.zh: 美国人尝试异国风味美食的渴望。

choices.text: The demand for information about food safety.
choices.zh: 对食品安全信息的需求。

choices.text: The fact that over half of Americans are overweight.
choices.zh: 超过半数美国人超重的事实。

choices.text: The fact that science books are difficult to read.
choices.zh: 科学书籍难以阅读的事实。

items.stem: Who does the man say his last book was mainly written for?

choices.text: The general public.
choices.zh: 普通大众。

choices.text: Those who are overweight.
choices.zh: 超重人群。

choices.text: Those who want to lose weight.
choices.zh: 想要减肥的人。

choices.text: The medical community.
choices.zh: 医学界。

items.stem: What does the man recommend people do?

choices.text: Switch to a vegetarian diet.
choices.zh: 改吃素食。

choices.text: Follow a personalized diet.
choices.zh: 遵循个性化饮食方案。

choices.text: Adhere to doctors' advice.
choices.zh: 听从医生的建议。

choices.text: Cut carbohydrate intake.
choices.zh: 减少碳水化合物摄入。

items.stem: What did researchers discover about rats placed briefly in a stressful situation?

choices.text: The rate of their growth increased dramatically.
choices.zh: 它们的生长速度显著加快。

choices.text: The growth of their new brain cells doubled.
choices.zh: 它们新生脑细胞的增长翻了一番。

choices.text: They began to show signs of depression.
choices.zh: 它们开始表现出抑郁的迹象。

choices.text: They began to get irritated and restless.
choices.zh: 它们开始变得烦躁不安。

items.stem: Why do people tend to have clear memories of dangerous situations they have encountered?

choices.text: To avoid them in the future.
choices.zh: 为了在将来避免这些情境。

choices.text: To warn others against them.
choices.zh: 为了警告他人不要遭遇这些情境。

choices.text: To make good sense of them.
choices.zh: 为了合理理解这些情境。

choices.text: To reflect on their causes.
choices.zh: 为了反思这些情境的起因。

items.stem: What do scientists believe chronic stress can do?

choices.text: Produce a surprising healing effect.
choices.zh: 产生令人惊讶的疗愈效果。

choices.text: Weaken one's immunity in the long run.
choices.zh: 从长远来看削弱人的免疫力。

choices.text: Make people more susceptible to illness.
choices.zh: 使人更容易生病。

choices.text: Provide protection against mental illnesses.
choices.zh: 提供针对精神疾病的保护。

items.stem: What does the speaker say is a common problem with managers?

choices.text: Placing their own interests over their staff's.
choices.zh: 将自己的利益置于员工之上。

choices.text: Being overwhelmed by their daily routines.
choices.zh: 被日常事务压得喘不过气来。

choices.text: Lacking the ability to relate to their staff.
choices.zh: 缺乏与员工建立联系的能力。

choices.text: Spending too much time handling email.
choices.zh: 花费太多时间处理电子邮件。

items.stem: What may happen when managers ignore minor problems?

choices.text: Their leadership may be challenged.
choices.zh: 他们的领导力可能会受到挑战。

choices.text: Their companies may go bankrupt.
choices.zh: 他们的公司可能会破产。

choices.text: Unexpected events may occur.
choices.zh: 可能会出现意外事件。

choices.text: Major problems may result.
choices.zh: 可能会导致重大问题。

items.stem: What are leaders expected to do in pursuing their strategic goals?

choices.text: Keep an eye on their employees.
choices.zh: 密切关注他们的员工。

choices.text: Motivate and inspire their team.
choices.zh: 激励和鼓舞他们的团队。

choices.text: Sacrifice some of the immediate goals.
choices.zh: 牺牲一些眼前目标。

choices.text: Have greater ambition in overall planning.
choices.zh: 在整体规划中具有更大的雄心。

items.stem: How can a manager best avoid being distracted by email?

choices.text: Cultivate self-control.
choices.zh: 培养自我控制能力。

choices.text: Filter their email boxes.
choices.zh: 过滤他们的电子邮件收件箱。

choices.text: Respond only after work.
choices.zh: 仅在下班后回复。

choices.text: Check only when necessary.
choices.zh: 仅在必要时查看。

items.stem: What does the speaker say a team of marketing professors has studied?

choices.text: The key to increasing healthy food supply.
choices.zh: 增加健康食品供应的关键。

choices.text: The best way to improve marketing research.
choices.zh: 改进营销研究的最佳方法。

choices.text: The impact of advertisements on consumption.
choices.zh: 广告对消费的影响。

choices.text: The importance of the appearance of food.
choices.zh: 食物外观的重要性。

items.stem: How have medical professionals tried to fight obesity?

choices.text: By focusing on the nutrients in different foods.
choices.zh: 通过关注不同食物中的营养成分。

choices.text: By emphasizing the diversity of food.
choices.zh: 通过强调食物的多样性。

choices.text: By stressing pleasing aesthetics of food.
choices.zh: 通过强调食物赏心悦目的美感。

choices.text: By winning the support of marketing professors.
choices.zh: 通过赢得营销学教授的支持。

items.stem: What can other companies learn from the example of the carrot promotion campaign?

choices.text: They can attract customers with the healthy qualities of their products.
choices.zh: 它们可以用产品的健康品质吸引顾客。

choices.text: They can boost sales of healthy foods by making them visually appealing.
choices.zh: 它们可以通过使健康食品在视觉上更吸引人来提升销量。

choices.text: They can turn to marketing professors for advice.
choices.zh: 它们可以向营销学教授寻求建议。

choices.text: They can rely on advertising for sales promotion.
choices.zh: 它们可以依靠广告进行促销。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the cleaning products industry in recent years?

choices.text: It has witnessed a spectacular surge in demand.
choices.zh: 该行业需求出现了惊人的激增。

choices.text: It has met much criticism from environmentalists.
choices.zh: 该行业受到了环保主义者的诸多批评。

choices.text: It has seen more small businesses offering environment-friendly products.
choices.zh: 该行业出现了更多提供环保产品的小企业。

choices.text: It has experienced increasingly fierce competition among global companies.
choices.zh: 该行业经历了全球公司之间日益激烈的竞争。

items.stem: Why are newly developed cleaning products selling well?

choices.text: Consumers now know much more about technology.
choices.zh: 消费者现在对技术了解得多得多。

choices.text: Their mass production has sharply reduced the price
choices.zh: 它们的大规模生产大幅降低了价格。

choices.text: Consumers tend to favor all that is novel.
choices.zh: 消费者倾向于青睐一切新颖的东西。

choices.text: Their quality has been greatly improved.
choices.zh: 它们的质量得到了极大改善。

items.stem: What are some customers doing to help promote non-traditional cleaning products?

choices.text: Purchasing only this kind of products for home cleaning.
choices.zh: 只购买这类产品用于家庭清洁。

choices.text: Writing positive comments about them on social media.
choices.zh: 在社交媒体上撰写关于它们的正面评论。

choices.text: Demonstrating on TV how effective these products are.
choices.zh: 在电视上演示这些产品有多有效。

choices.text: Telling one another about their incomparable virtues.
choices.zh: 相互告知它们无可比拟的优点。

items.stem: What problem might be caused by the growing piles of coins in fountains?

choices.text: Increasing cleaners' workload.
choices.zh: 增加清洁工的工作量。

choices.text: Blocking the fountains' works.
choices.zh: 堵塞喷泉的运作装置。

choices.text: Breaking a time-honored ritual.
choices.zh: 破坏一项由来已久的仪式。

choices.text: Polluting the fountains' water.
choices.zh: 污染喷泉的水。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the coins collected from New York City's park fountains?

choices.text: They are occasionally retrieved by curious tourists.
choices.zh: 它们偶尔会被好奇的游客取走。

choices.text: They are regularly donated to charity organizations.
choices.zh: 它们定期捐赠给慈善组织。

choices.text: They are mostly used for the fountains' maintenance.
choices.zh: 它们大多用于喷泉的维护。

choices.text: They are usually used as wages for fountain cleaners.
choices.zh: 它们通常用作喷泉清洁工的工资。

items.stem: What do we learn about the money collected from Rome's Trevi Fountain?

choices.text: It is invested in a series of businesses.
choices.zh: 它被投资于一系列生意。

choices.text: It is used exclusively for its maintenance.
choices.zh: 它专门用于该喷泉的维护。

choices.text: It is used to run a supermarket for the needy.
choices.zh: 它被用来经营一家为贫困者服务的超市。

choices.text: It is estimated to be about $40,000 a month.
choices.zh: 它估计每月约为40000美元。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Thomas Morgan?

choices.text: He was arrested for stealing money from four fountain cleaners.
choices.zh: 他因从四名喷泉清洁工那里偷钱而被逮捕。

choices.text: He was sentenced to 34 years' imprisonment.
choices.zh: 他被判处34年监禁。

choices.text: He collected rare coins from around the world.
choices.zh: 他收集来自世界各地的稀有硬币。

choices.text: He stole a lot of money from a fountain with a magnetic stick.
choices.zh: 他用磁棒从喷泉中偷了很多钱。
